result.reason: The redline appropriately limits exclusivity to Deerskin Products and twelve months, while preserving HDI’s reciprocal covenant and the general termination framework. However, the automatic release is triggered by failure to perform a “material obligation under Article 1,” rather than expressly by any failure to meet applicable service levels or delivery dates. Although Section 1.6 dates are covered, the operative text does not clearly cover all service-level failures, and it potentially extends the trigger to unrelated material Article 1 obligations. The margin comment cannot cure that mismatch.
